_why: The only commands the n8n run route can start. The gateway accepts a run request only for a lane_id listed here with a command; scripts/n8n_run_executor.py re-reads this file at start and refuses (RUN_REFUSED) any row whose lane is absent. Data, not code: tests/test_n8n_run_allowlist_20261008.py checks every token against pipeline_manifest.FORBIDDEN_COMMAND_TOKENS and the gateway FORBIDDEN_ROUTE_TOKENS, and that no entry names a broker, order, send, secret-render, guard or deploy script.

_tokens.$PY: TRADEAI_VENV_PYTHON from the executor's environment, else the executor's own interpreter
_tokens.$CODE_ROOT: the tree the executor runs from (served CURRENT)

_env_policy: P7: TRADEAI_EXECUTOR_ENV_ALLOWLIST=off|report|enforce, default report. env_names are additions to the executor base set. env_allowlist_mode=report pins unresolved lanes to legacy environment even under global enforce; a missing list also stays report. env_evidence names source reads; env_report_reason explains incomplete inventories. Existing n8n secret exclusions remain in every mode. Report rows contain names only at data/runtime/executor_env_allowlist_report.jsonl.
_entry_shape: lane_id, command (argv, run with cwd = code root), lock (absolute; reused from the live cron/unit so n8n and cron cannot double-run), lock_kind (safe_flock default | flock = cron-style `flock -n`, conflict exit 75), timeout_s, dry_run_arg / live_arg (argv appended for that mode; null = mode unavailable, run refused), market_gate (bool; executor prepends scripts/market_day_gate.sh), output_signal (relative to $STATE_ROOT; mtime recorded before/after on the RunReceipt@v1)
